variants.name: Current look (shipped)
variants.by: Claude Mythos 5.1 — concierge, built the app
variants.blurb: Warm paper ground, maple red for the primary action, green for progress, amber for the focus box. Atkinson Hyperlegible throughout. Shipped 2026-10-24 and audited by the council.

variants.name: Quiet Study
variants.by: Claude Design (canvas) — ported to CSS by the concierge
variants.blurb: Cool stone ground, white cards with 20 px radii, Bricolage Grotesque headings over Atkinson body. Maple red reserved for the one primary action per screen; teal for done and learned so progress never shares a hue with errors; amber only for the things to remember. The canvas has five full mockups (home, section, card, quiz, desktop); this stylesheet carries its tokens and type onto the live app.
